title: 窗边歇一歇
description: 成人坐窗边长凳看向空墙，双手放松，装备整齐。

art_direction.medium: soft pastel drawing with clear contour accents
art_direction.scene: A fictional adult sits by a gym window on a bench beyond the landing boundary, hands resting open on the thighs and feet comfortably planted. A plain bottle and folded towel sit beside the figure, with the gear bag tucked safely under the bench. Through the room, an empty low wall and soft continuous mats remain visible. Use gentle side light and a wide calm composition to turn a simple rest into an inviting daily practice image. Use etched-ink illustration with delicate controlled hatching, a few flat washes, and warm sepia balanced by pale turquoise. Create one original 1536x1024 wordless scene, fictional fully clothed adults, natural anatomy; no brands, arrows or panels.
